hook: PostgreSQL 19 is here, and it fixes old pain.

beats.say: The new REPACK CONCURRENTLY command reorganizes tables for your current workload without disrupting ongoing operations, so no more downtime just to tidy a bloated table.
A new pg plan advice extension gives better control over plan stability, standbys now support read-your-writes consistency, and a get-or-create behavior saves a network round trip.
Also new: md5 passwords now trigger a warning ahead of removal, and LZ4 builds use lz4 as the default TOAST compression.
